TOOLING BURST T4v — T4v — Frozen Orb (G1 + scheduled child emission + expiry burst) (Run C-5, E3; architecture 03- § 2.2 grammars, § 2.3 alphabet; specs are conductor-authored with VERIFY flags — implement the spec as written and report any field that the primitives or the runtime cannot honour). task_id "T4v".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a, T4b, T4f, T4h (all clauses), T4p, T4q, T4r and the new row "T4v — Frozen Orb (G1 + scheduled child emission + expiry burst)" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. runs/C-5/specs/frozen_orb.json (the specs — LAW: the renderer never selects targets or infers grammar from a name), export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py (G1 component, pieces phase, screen_px, key states, T4r's burst_v1r + decal), export/vfx_material.gdshader, oracle/peak_pieces.py (run only), the primitives (512 working copies, four-plane greyscale RGBA unless noted): VF-prim-ice-puff-01/ice_puff_01_512.png (the orb body), VF-prim-ice-shard-01/ice_shard_01_512.png (child bolts + expiry shards), the ice peak pieces from T4r (expiry burst) and VF-prim-ice-crown-01/ice_crown_01_512.png (decal), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json and ice_bolt_e2/kit.json (templates), tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

BUILD Frozen Orb on the G1 component with two extensions: (1) EMISSION — while the orb travels (speed 420 px/s, range 640 px, pierce −1 per T4f), emit a child ice bolt every 2 frames on a spiral (3 per revolution, angle advancing 120° + 17° per emission, seeded) — each child = the ice shard primitive oriented along its velocity, speed 900 px/s, range 260 px, pooled (T4b pool), pierce 0, contact = a small strike flash + tint, no burst; (2) EXPIRY — at range or 1.5 s: hold 2 frames, then a 16-shard radial burst from the orb's position (the ice peak pieces on burst_v1r as T4r built it) + the frost-crown decal; (3) the ORB body = the angular puff primitive rotating slowly (one turn per 1.2 s) with a 4-shard rim (ice shard primitive ×4 at 90°, rotating with it), on the T4a material, ice palette, screen_px; (4) kit `frozen_orb_e3` registered — the legacy `frozen_orb` (the Frozen Orb v3 sheets) stays untouched as the breadth-test kit.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4v/acceptance.json): headless trace of one cast east through the dummy pack: orb passes through (pierce −1) all the way to range, child emission count ≈ flight_frames/2 with the spiral angles logged, children pooled (no node growth beyond the pool), expiry burst at the range point with 16 shards + decal; kit validates; previously registered kits byte-identical; in-sandbox suite reds named.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): kit validation; the emitted scenes contain the named nodes; headless clock traces per the ACCEPTANCE; all previously registered kits export byte-identically; headless import exit 0.
DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/ (run only), export/replay.py, any test file except the three named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4v/, the new kit directories named above and their registration lines in kits_v9.json. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4v/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4v"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
